The '''Yaka system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located near the [[Perave system]] within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yaka (planet)|Yaka]]. It was home to the [[Yaka]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Around [[490 BBY]], the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanians]] conquered the system and began cybernetically enhancing the Yaka people.
